tokscale_window: Tokscale only publishes the last 12 months.
note_tagline: Notes, todos and calendar that sync across your devices
note_unreleased: No release yet. Build it from the source in the meantime.
note_feature_vault_body: Notes are .md files in a folder you pick, with live preview, wikilinks, backlinks and an outline.
note_feature_canvas_body: Lay out cards on a JSON Canvas board and follow links through the graph view.
note_feature_plan_body: Plan the day next to your notes with a month calendar and a todo board.
note_feature_sync_body: Pair devices with a code and sync them directly, without an account or a sync server.
note_feature_eris_body: Calendar events sync with the Eris panel, and notes cited in an event open straight in Note.
note_feature_workspace_body: A desktop-first workspace with a command palette, on Windows and Android.
